book.name: Genesis
book.title: Genesis Mosesna Moamba Memba, Indhanana Pholmomba.

content: Yosepva Isipra Avna, Beswonam Waiandra Vawovna.

Doa Ismaelnindva Yosepmba Potipainda dasvhohalvona, wo Yosepva Potipana deuvmera andra vawovna. No Potipava kuwul wulluhunvna polisimba, no polisiva kekalvho vruwuvna Perona deuvmba, wo no Perova Isipna mendekli kuwul himba wulluhunvna.
Doa Yaweva Yosepmba nesmos vrevna, wo Yosepva andrava vevnamba manimani, hena andrava beswonam phovna.
Wo Potipava doa nonglana, osva Yawe Yosepmba nesmos vrev, wo Yosepva andra vev beswonamangas noinda.
Wo hevpa os vevna, lehra yimba andra vev kana andrava, wo omnana, kana kekalvho vro deuvmoa wohnahonam.
Wo nonamba Yaweva keknam vewol vevna Potipatatanamba. Hevpa keknam vewol vevna wohm eva indhanam, di Potipana deuvmera eva osom.

Wo Potipava Yosepm omnana, ye kanamba si kekalvho vrevav, wo hevpa nengvnamoa mana vemamba, owai, himba ambo hevna innemangas nengvna nelm. Potipana Ongal Yosepm Mindnam Newond Ovrevna. Wo nihva Yosepnamba besal lohvna.
Wo dawonam Potipana ongal nonglana ona, pai besal hevm, kam wailira.
Wo Yosep omnana, kamba owai. Potipa yena tlapevpa kana kuwulva kamba os omnana, yeoa kanamoa deuvmoa wohmoa kekalvho vro, wo noinda himba nengowol vevmoa mana vemamba.
Honamba deuvnamba ka kuwulva wulluhv, osva hevpa temba, wo kamba ovomnanamoa mana vemamba, yemangas hena ongalm. Es hevpa kava osva sahonamba vevav Sesoana novrava, owai.

Wo elsus ungevliriniva nomba Yosepmba ishomnavna mindnam, kam wailu. Heva os owai, Yosepva henamba moamba hellevnamoa, osva ovna, lehra kamba omnav, wo wailinamoa. Yosepva murapetava gavnamoa domba ungevlirini indamba, owai.
Potipana Ongal Potipam Moangakalamoa Ishomnavna Hehlanam.
Wo Yosepva deuvra sihanamba, andram velm, wo monglava andranindva diva aevulvnamoa,

wo Potipana ongal kayenm keknam kevremnana Yosepnam, wo hev omnana, ye kam wailu. Wo owai, Yosepva deuvmeriniva amballam wohpholahangana dandwonam, ungevlirini di Yosepna kayenmba englana moanvulamnana.

Doa wunuhunna andranindm, hev gekala ona, nunglu, kana tlal waiprona nom Hipru tendorinim Yosepm pina deuvram, wo pim sahokla vewol vevna. Kana deuvmeram sihaiva, wo kam omnavna, yem ka waili. Heva os owai, ka mindnam wunuhoiva.
Wo himba kam helleiva, pai, wunuhov, doa noinda hevna kayenmba moanvelahaphoi amballam, wohpholahangai.
Wo Potipana ongalva moanvulamnana kayenmba Yosepnamba, venamba, hevna tlal deuvram dom prona.
Doa hev tlalm gekala omnana mongawamoa noi ambo. Hev ona, honamba Hiprunindriniva, yimba memba waiprunnamba Yosepva, hev proiva deuvmeram dom kaindam, wo kam sahokla vrelm vevna.
Wo ka wunuhoiva, wo di hevna kayenmba moanvelahaphoi kana englara, amballam wohpholahangai. Ungevlirini ishovna, wo hev ona, noi yena andranindriniva kam os venavna.
Doa Potipa hellenamba, wo esvema tandna,
wo hev hevna polisim unna, Yosepm kevru, buiram wolaihasuvu. Wo polisi kevrinamba, buira wolaihasuvna di buiduvra, ten Pero kuwulna buinind aevulvnam.
Yosepva Buinindnamba Kuwul Wulluhunvna.
Wo heva os Yawe Yosepm mendah nesmos vrevna,
wo noinda buinindna kuwulva Yosepm und vevna, omnana, yeoa kekalvho vewol veo buinindmoa monglamoa. Wo Yosep kuwulva buinindnamba wulluhunvna, wo andramba eva henamba kekalvho vrinvnata.

Wo Yaweva beswonam vewol venavna Yosepmba, wo noinda Yosepva andra vevna manimani, wo nomba beswonamangas phovna. Wo kuwulva buinindnamba nengvnamoa mana vemamba, Yosepva kekalvho vewol vevnamba. Manara, Yawe Yosepmba waiandra vevna.
